passage:
The school held a poster contest about saving energy. Many posters used bright colors and big words.
A quiet student named Lily made a simple poster. It showed one empty classroom with the lights still on. At the bottom, it said, "No one is here, but the light is still working."
Some students thought it was too plain. But the judges chose it as the winner because the message was clear.
After the poster was placed near the office, students began turning off lights more often.
Lily's poster showed that strong communication does not always need many colors or words. A simple picture can make people stop and think.
